domains.setup_detail: No port forwarding, and it works behind carrier-grade NAT.
domains.setup_dialog_intro: Two things from your Cloudflare account. This server creates the tunnel, adds the DNS record and saves the address.
domains.setup_hostname_hint: The address people will use. Its domain must be on your Cloudflare account.
domains.setup_hostname_invalid: That is not a hostname. Try something like media.example.com.
domains.setup_token_hint: Needs Cloudflare Tunnel: Edit and DNS: Edit. Used once and not stored.
domains.tunnel_disconnect_message: This server stops being reachable from outside your network, and links you have sent stop working. The tunnel and its DNS record stay in your Cloudflare account.
domains.manual_detail: You have a domain, and a router you can forward a port on.
domains.manual_intro: Save the domain, then point it at this server.
domains.manual_step1_title: Give this machine a fixed address on your network
domains.manual_step1_body: In your router, reserve {{lan}} for it. Without this, the next step points at the wrong machine after a reboot.
domains.manual_step2_body: Forward TCP port 443 to port {{port}} on this machine. If your router's external address starts with 10., 172.16-31 or 100.64-127, you are behind carrier-grade NAT and forwarding will not work. Use Cloudflare instead.
domains.manual_step3_body: Add an A record for your domain pointing at the external address your router shows. Home addresses change, so use dynamic DNS unless yours is fixed.
domains.manual_step4_body: Put cert.pem and key.pem in {{tls}}. Without a certificate, a browser will not trust the domain and cannot sign anybody in. Renewals are picked up automatically.
domains.manual_proxy: Already running Caddy, nginx or your own tunnel? It handles HTTPS, so the steps above are already done.
domains.manual_tls_folder: the tls folder in this server's data directory
domains.switch_stop_tunnel_message: Your server is reached through your own domain instead. The tunnel stays in your Cloudflare account.
domains.detected_message: You are connected through this address. Saving it lets invite links use it.
